sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Hovering the "#" cell of a live track shows a release group card for that track's event. For the main event it is the release's own release group. For any other event, a search looks for a release group named exactly like the event: the Disambiguation without "live, " and without a trailing "; …". The search runs once per event, only when you hover. A found group gets the same card as the header link. Otherwise the card says so and lists the closest titles the search returned. Alt+click the cell to open the release group, or the search, on musicbrainz.org. Four new settings in ⚙️ Settings → 💿 RELEASE TRACKLIST: switch the card off, search the words instead of the exact phrase, search only the release's artist, and set how many closest titles to show.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Tracks from different events are now told apart in the "#" column. Instead of one light green for every track outside the main event, each event gets its own tint and a small chip, "E1", "E2", …, numbered by date. The chips stay readable without colour. Hovering the "🎪 N events" badge shows a legend with each event's tint, chip and number of tracks. A track whose linked event is named without a date, such as "68th Academy Awards", now takes its event from the dated recording comment.
